A '''language''' was used by the [[Pitrillistian]]s, a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the distant<ref name="Galaxy7" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Pitrillistia system/Legends|Pitrillistia system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pitrillistia]]. It mostly consisted of buzz-like sounds created by the Pitrillistians' small [[Limb/Legends|wings]] that were located underneath their two-piece shells. Those sounds of the [[Language/Legends|language]] had a [[Music/Legends|musical]] character.<ref name="Galaxy7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pitrillistians and their language were created by [[Desset Fabien]] through the "[[Design An Alien]]" competition run in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine]]''.<ref name="Galaxy7" /> The competition, launched in the magazine's [[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 3|third issue]]<ref name="Galaxy3">{{GalaxyCite|3|Design An Alien|Design An Alien Contest}}</ref> in [[April]] [[1995]],<ref name="DateGalaxy3">{{GalaxyCite|2|Rebel Report}}</ref> called for readers to create completely new [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species inspired by the [[original trilogy]] of ''[[Star Wars]]'' films. Fabien was nineteen years of age when they submitted their entry on the Pitrillistians, which was later published in the [[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 7|seventh issue]]<ref name="Galaxy7" /> in April [[1996]],<ref name="DateGalaxy7">{{GalaxyCite|6|Around the Galaxy}}</ref> under the "honorable mentions" section of the "16 and up" subdivision.<ref name="Galaxy7" /> [[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]], who maintains the [[Holocron continuity database]], later stated that published material from the "Design An Alien" competition was considered [[canon]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="tt">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=690#14724917|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-03|time=5:45 PM|quote=Yes, though any text discrepencies [sic] with other sources would [sic] likely to superceded [sic] by the other source.}} {{C|In response to: "Star Wars Galaxy Magazine #7 published the winners of the 'Design an Alien' contest, where fans were encouraged to submit artwork and backstories of new SW aliens. Are these aliens canon?"}}</ref>
